answer: In this Proof of Agent design, each bonded identity is an escrowed liability: when k identities coordinate equivocation, correlated evidence applies O(k^2) slashing across their collateral rather than treating violations independently. Detection also triggers asymmetric capital depreciation, imposing an exponential multiplier on the swarm’s remaining value. Thus a sybil operator cannot cheaply replicate influence; every added identity deepens the penalty river, while relic and shale balances become progressively harder to recover.
